source_title: SlideShow Maker Photo to Video — US App Store
observation: The US listing showed about 104K ratings and a 4.2 rating for a photo-to-video slideshow app, a large but non-revenue proxy for established consumer behavior.
denominator: US App Store ratings displayed at access
limitations: Ratings do not reveal downloads, revenue, retention or the share of US users.
The count is rounded by the storefront.

source_title: SlideShow Maker Photo to Video — in-app purchases
observation: The listing displayed weekly in-app purchase options around $4.99-$9.99, showing an active price architecture but not completed transactions.
denominator: in-app purchase options shown on the listing
limitations: List price is not realized willingness to pay or unit economics.

source_title: Slideshow Maker Video & Photo — US App Store
observation: A second slideshow app showed about 17K ratings and a 4.8 rating, supporting that the behavior is not isolated to one incumbent.
denominator: US App Store ratings displayed at access
limitations: Rating count is a demand proxy, not evidence that a new entrant can acquire users profitably.

source_title: Slideshow Maker & Creator — US App Store reviews
data_period: reviews visible on listing at access
observation: Visible reviews included objections to subscription pricing and cloud/privacy handling, supporting a local, no-account and one-time-price wedge.
unit: named complaint themes in visible reviews
denominator: non-random reviews visible on the listing
limitations: Visible reviews are selected by the storefront and cannot establish theme prevalence.
A stated complaint does not prove product switching or payment.

source_title: SlideShow Maker Photo to Video — US App Store reviews
data_period: reviews visible on listing at access
observation: Visible reviews reported project loss, restart bugs, inability to finish a show after paying and confusing cancellation, making autosave and a transparent purchase model testable missed insights.
unit: named complaint themes in visible reviews
denominator: non-random reviews visible on the listing
limitations: Quick Scan did not perform stratified review mining; no market-wide frequency is inferred.

source_title: Dazz Cam — Vintage Camera — US App Store
data_period: listing and US Photo & Video chart accessed 2026-07-18
observation: Dazz Cam showed about 111K ratings, a 4.8 rating and a current US Photo & Video chart position around the top 25, supporting ongoing appetite for stylized personal-media creation.
denominator: US App Store ratings displayed at access
limitations: This is an adjacent camera behavior, not occasion-reel product demand.

source_title: SlideShow Maker Photo to Video occasion templates
observation: The listing markets multiple episodic occasions, supporting a natural but infrequent return cycle rather than continuous weekly utility.
limitations: No product-specific repeat-use cohort was observed.

source_title: Before & After Video Maker local iOS listing
observation: A 5.5 MB iOS app advertises offline photo-to-video creation and no data collection at a $3.99 one-time price, supporting practical local rendering for a bounded media workflow.
limitations: The adjacent app does not prove quality or reliability for 8-30-photo occasion projects.

observation: The proposed scope processes only user-selected personal media, defaults to local rendering, uses no public feed and makes no claim to licensed music or third-party content rights.
